1. (Currently amended) An ultrasonic surgical instrument assembly comprising: a handpiece; a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece; a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; and a light source attached to said handpiece so as to direct at least visible electromagnetic radiation along the probe towards a surgical site distal of the probe, wherein said light source is positioned at a proximal end of said handpiece with an optical fiber extending from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece.

2. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1, further comprising a power supply mounted at least indirectly to said handpiece and operatively connected to said light source, wherein said power supply is separate from said handpiece and removably attached thereto.

3. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2 wherein said power supply includes a coil and an additional fastener, said coil being disposable about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, and said additional fastener removably attaching said coil about the power cable.

4. (Original)

5. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2, further comprising a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece, wherein said fastener is selected from the group consisting of a clip, a clamp, and a band.

6. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 5, further comprising at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece, wherein said power supply is a battery.

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Currently amended) The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source includes a light-emitting diode and said light source is positioned at a proximal or rear end of said handpiece.

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Cancelled)

11. (Currently amended) An accessory for a surgical instrument comprising a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece, and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, wherein said power supply component is separate from said handpiece.

12. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a coil and an additional fastener, said coil being disposable about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, and said additional fastener removably attaching said coil about the power cable.

13. (Original)

14. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a battery removably attachable to said handpiece.

15. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said light source includes a light-emitting diode positioned at a proximal or rear end of said handpiece.

16. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber and at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said optical fiber to said handpiece so that said optical fiber extends from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece.

17. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a distal end of said handpiece and for orienting said light source to provide illumination along said probe to a surgical site, wherein said light source is a light-emitting diode.

18. (Currently amended) The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is taken from the group consisting of a clip, a clamp, and a band.

19. (Currently amended) A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying a fastener to said handpiece to attach said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directed along said probe; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source.

20. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19 further comprising removably mounting said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece, wherein said power supply is a battery.

21. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 20 wherein said power supply includes a coil and an additional fastener, the removable mounting of said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece including disposing said coil about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator and using said additional fastener to removably attach said coil about the power cable.

22. (Original)

23. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19, further comprising removing said fastener and said light source from said handpiece after completion of an operation on said surgical site, wherein said fastener is selected from the group consisting of a clip, a clamp, and a band.

24. (Currently amended) The surgical method defined in claim 19 wherein the applying of said fastener includes positioning said light source at a proximal or rear end of said handpiece and using a light-emitting diode as said light source, further comprising attaching an optical fiber to said handpiece so that said fiber extends from said light source at said proximal end of said handpiece to a distal end of said handpiece.

25. (Currently amended) An accessory for a medical instrument comprising a handpiece and a probe or tool extension on a distal end of said handpiece, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said instrument; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, said power supply component including a coil and an additional fastener, said coil being disposable about a power cable extending to said handpiece, and said additional fastener removably attaching said coil about the power cable.

26. (Original)
